name: Mount Shaohua band
note: Zhu Wu leads Chen Da and Yang Chun; they hold the hill when Shi Jin is drawn into their quarrel (ch. 2-3).

name: Mount Taohua band
note: Zhou Tong holds the hill; Li Zhong joins him in the novel but starts free at Weizhou in our data (RULING K-1).

name: Mount Erlong band
note: Deng Long, Green-Eyed Tiger, holds the monastery hill until Lu Zhishen and Yang Zhi take it (ch. 17); the takeover is not scripted (RULING K-1).

name: Mount Qingfeng band
note: Yan Shun, Wang Ying and Zheng Tianshou hold the hill above Qingfeng Fort (ch. 32).

name: Mount Duiying band
note: Lyu Fang and Guo Sheng, rival halberdiers, share the hill until Xue Yong's duel brings them together (ch. 35).

name: Mount Mangdang band
note: Fan Rui, Xiang Chong and Li Gun hold the hill near the Grand Canal (ch. 58).

name: Mount Huangmen band
note: Ou Peng, Ma Lin and Tao Zongwang hold the hill; Jiang Jing, who is with them in the novel, starts free at Tanzhou in our data (RULING K-1).

name: Mount Dengyun band
note: Uncle Zou Yuan and nephew Zou Run hold the hill north of Dengzhou (ch. 49).
